about.title: About the data
about.intro: This site brings together public information about kindergartens and schools in Sofia so you can compare them in one place.

schools.title: Schools and their addresses
schools.body: The Ministry of Education and Science register of schools and kindergartens: names, types, grades and addresses.

kindergartens.title: Municipal kindergartens
kindergartens.body: Sofia Municipality’s kindergarten enrolment system: kindergartens, their groups and locations.
kindergartens.coverage: We list all municipal kindergartens and nurseries published on Sofia Municipality’s system (about 200 kindergartens and 25 nurseries), plus the state kindergartens run by the Ministry of Defence. Where we could not place an address precisely, the kindergarten is listed without a map pin or distance. Applications and places are handled at kg.sofia.bg.

nvo.title: NVO exam results
nvo.body: Official results of the national external assessments (NVO) for 4th, 7th and 10th grade, published by the Ministry of Education and Science as open data. We show each school’s average in Bulgarian and maths, and the average of the Sofia schools’ results for the same exam and year.

dzi.title: Matura exam results (DZI)
dzi.body: Official results of the 12th-grade state matura exams (May–June session) for each school, published by the Ministry of Education and Science as open data. We show each school’s average grade per subject on the 2–6 scale. The ministry’s portal keeps only recent years, so older results are not available.

prices.title: Private school fees
prices.body: Taken from each school’s own website and shown only where the page states the price. Every price is marked with its source, and the comparison page links to the page it came from and shows when we checked it. Fees change, so confirm with the school before deciding.

addresses.title: Building locations in Sofia
addresses.body: Sofia Municipality’s open data from ГИС-София: the official address register and the points of municipal schools and kindergartens, used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (CC BY 4.0). We match each school’s address to them and do not change the data.

maps.title: Maps and distances
maps.body: Where Sofia’s data has no match, a location comes from OpenStreetMap or the school’s own website, and is shown on the map only when it lands on the school’s address. Map tiles by CARTO. Distances are straight-line, not travel distance.

about.ageTitle: How age groups are worked out
about.ageBody: In Bulgaria the group depends on the calendar year of birth, not the exact birthday: group = enrolment year − birth year. Children born on 1 January and 31 December of the same year join the same group.
about.limitsBody: Admission results come from the official Sofia ranking lists (kg.sofia.bg) and the РУО София-град minimum scores. The official sites keep only the current year, so our history starts in 2026 for kindergartens and first grade and in 2022 for eighth grade. Where we have no reliable data we leave the field out rather than guess.

privacy.account: You do not need an account, and the site sets no cookies.
privacy.browser: If you set a starting location, it is saved in your browser together with a few display choices, so they are still there on your next visit. They are not sent to us.
privacy.lookups: When you type an address or pick a point on the map, the address or coordinates are sent to OpenStreetMap’s Nominatim service to look them up. Map images are loaded from CARTO. Both see your IP address, as any website you visit does.
privacy.searches: When a school name you search for finds nothing, we count the words you typed, so we can add the names parents use. We keep only the words and how often they came up each day, nothing about who searched, and we leave out anything that looks like an email, a phone number or a web address.
privacy.hosting: The site is served through Cloudflare, and our server keeps standard request logs that include IP addresses, for security and troubleshooting. We count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which uses no cookies and does not follow you across sites.
privacy.contact: If you email us, we use your address only to reply. Questions about privacy: {{email}}.
privacy.calculator: The admission calculator works entirely in your browser: your answers are never sent to us. If you press "Save on this device", they are kept in your browser (with the address you checked) so the school list can compare every school; you can forget them at any time.

admissionCalc.title: Admission points calculator
admissionCalc.intro: Work out your child's points for a Sofia municipal kindergarten or a preparatory group (including one at a school), the group and extra points for first grade, or the score for eighth grade, under the official rules for the year you pick.
admissionCalc.privacy: Your answers stay in this browser. They are not sent to us or put in the page address, and they are kept only if you save them on this device.
admissionCalc.privateAnswers: These answers stay in your browser like all the others. Leave them as No if they do not apply.
admissionCalc.disclaimer: This is an estimate from the published rules, not a decision. The official system and the school or kindergarten decide; places, applicants and rules change every year, and ties are broken by a random number.
admissionCalc.grade5Note: 5th grade has no common points system in Sofia: each school that admits pupils sets its own rules.
admissionCalc.preparatoryNote: Preparatory groups at schools (the year or two before 1st grade) are ranked like kindergartens, not like 1st grade.
admissionCalc.stillRanking: The {{year}}/{{next}} ranking is still running for free places.
admissionCalc.noRules: There are no rules for this stage yet.
admissionCalc.rangeNote: A range means some questions are unanswered or "Not sure": the top of the range assumes each of them goes your way.
admissionCalc.noPointItems: No points from these answers yet.
